verdict.rationale: Kit exposes account data (subscribers, engagement, broadcasts stats) via its MCP server, letting connected AI agents generate natural-language suggestions like drafting a broadcast from segment data, and it ships 'subscriber engagement scoring' as a data feature. However there's no evidence of native, in-product AI-generated insights/dashboards — the AI capability requires an external MCP client rather than being built into the Kit UI itself. Missing for 10: in-app AI insight/suggestion UI, evidence of automated analysis or recommendations surfaced natively in the product, independent user reports of this in action.
